summary: English and Hindi first-party discovery evidenced the Supaul district land-record custodian and Bihar's BhuNaksha cadastral viewer. The current public viewer returned hierarchy metadata for Supaul but bounded extent/plot requests did not yield usable anonymous parcel geometry or a stable parcel identity; no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, viewer bundle inspection, route requests, statuses, and limits are recorded in city-11323-supaul.json.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shifting performed.
